paper_metadata.title: Influence of Oxygen and Zirconium Contents on the Mechanical Properties of Ti-23Nb-0.7Ta-Zr-O Alloys

evidence.quote: Ti-23Nb-0.7Ta-(0, 2)Zr-(1.2, 4, 6, 10)O alloys were prepared using a non-consumable arc-melting method.
The alloys were melted three times using a KEJING MSM20-8 consumable arc-melting furnace ... under argon protection. The melting current was 600 A and the magnetic stirring current was 15 A.
2Zr-1.2O alloy was open-forged at 1080 °C and then 750 °C
2Zr-1.2O alloy was solutionized at 1010 °C for 30 min followed by water quenching
then the alloy was compressed at room temperature to 77% reduction in height with a constant crosshead speed of 0.1 mm/s
